task: Render B-02 artifact remote contract reinforcement
interpretation: 36 contract tests pass. The 3 failures are intentional failing regressions documenting mainline implementation gaps (G-1..G-3); they must not be xfail-marked and should turn green only after mainline fixes.
offline_guarantees: no ports listened, no network accessed (SitesStorageClient transport is replaced by an in-memory fake of the Qoder Sites functions surface)
no Supabase connection, no cloud Storage upload, no real secrets read
passed_contracts: byte-exact worker->remote->web round trip for binary payloads (all 256 byte values, 8 MiB deterministic, real zip/docx, utf-8 markdown) with matching SHA-256 and size
filenames with spaces, '%', parentheses and unicode round trip
exact 50 MB round trip; one byte over rejected on both upload and download
worker _sync_artifacts uploads every regular file with mapped content-type and correct bytes; skips oversized files; no-op without env
cross-container E2E: worker fs and web fs separate, joined only by the fake remote; binary artifacts verified byte-for-byte
remote listing never leaks other tasks; requests stay inside the task prefix
non-owner signature reuse uniformly 403 without remote probe
signature strictness: empty/garbage/extra-payload-key/rotated-secret all 403 before remote access; expired signature 403
wrong worker token maps to uniform 404 and sanitized listing, token never leaked
nonexistent task indistinguishable from missing artifact (same 404 detail)
malformed remote list entries (traversal-like names, bad size types/ranges, non-mappings) dropped
traversal filenames rejected even when the remote holds such keys; local symlink blocks remote fallback with uniform 404

mainline_gaps.finding: ArtifactStore.resolve()/_safe_file() serves a stale local same-name file and list() reports the stale local size even when newer authoritative remote bytes exist. Any shared-disk or re-run web/worker layout can hand out stale artifacts.

The artifact flow carries no integrity digest: remote bytes differing from upload-time SHA-256 (same plausible size) are served silently. The task-store metadata path supports checksum_sha256, but the artifact remote flow does not.

JSON artifacts cannot download remotely: worker stores them as application/json; SitesStorageClient._request then parses the payload instead of returning bytes, get_bytes() rejects it, and the web returns a uniform 404. Any .json artifact is cross-container-unreadable.

notes: Downloaded Content-Type is filename-derived; the worker-stored content-type is ignored on download (pinned by test_downloaded_content_type_is_derived_from_filename_not_stored_type).
Existing coverage in backend/tests/test_remote_artifacts.py and test_deployment_config.py was inventoried first; the new suite only adds missing scenarios and uses the real client classes end to end.
Real Qoder Storage / real cross-container deployment remains unverified by design.
